scope: all current and future material agent/chat/workflow tasks in Bedrijfsgeheugen Powerhouse
purpose: Prevent work from stopping at analysis, code, proposal, ready-for-deploy, or an unverified success claim. Require completion through production/live verification and canonical learning writeback whenever technically possible.
blocked_hard_boundary_rule: When a required write/deploy/provider action is technically unavailable or requires forbidden secrets, permission changes, destructive irreversible data operations, paid resource increases, or legally/financially binding action, complete every safe executable step, preserve an explicit canonical open obligation, and never claim the missing action was executed.
prevention: No current or future Powerhouse agent may stop at advice, local change, PR-ready, deploy-ready, or an unverified success claim when the next safe execution step is available. Work continues through live outcome verification and canonical learning writeback.
